literature.headline_zh: 埃博拉病毒类群本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期埃博拉病毒类群研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 该研究成功生成了微型基因组复制子细胞和 iVLP,并通过蛋白质组学分析,揭示了 EBOV RNP 与细胞骨架蛋白之间以前未被认识的关联。 [10.1016/j.virs.2026.11.007]
精液、眼液和母乳中病毒的持续存在凸显了 传播 即使在康复后仍具有持续的潜力。 [10.1007/s11908-026-00896-0]

papers.title: Community awareness, knowledge, attitudes, preventive behaviors, and intended responses to Ebola virus disease in Burao, Somaliland: implications for outbreak preparedness.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Understanding public awareness and responses to Ebola virus disease (EVD) may inform risk communication in settings without documented transmission. We assessed prior awareness among adults in Burao, Somaliland, and knowledge, attitudes, current behaviors, and hypothetical outbreak responses among those who had previously heard of EVD. METHODS: A community-based cross-sectional survey was conducted from 2 June to 21 July 2026 among adults aged 18 years or older who had lived in Burao for at least 6 months. Of 788 consenting adults, all contributed to the awareness and perception analyses; 387 who had previously heard of EVD completed detailed modules. Scores were analyzed continuously using multivariable linear regression and sensitivity analyses using interviewer-clustered standard errors and fractional logistic models. No design weights or verified sampling primary sampling unit identifiers were available. RESULTS: Of 788 consenting adults, 387 (49.1%) had previously heard of EVD. Only this previously aware subgroup (n = 387) completed the knowledge, attitude, current-behavior, and intended-response modules. Their mean knowledge, favorable-attitude, and intended-response scores were 60.6% (SD 24.1), 67.0% (SD 14.0), and 73.3% (SD 19.6), respectively. Post-secondary education was associated with prior awareness (adjusted prevalence ratio 1.87, 95% CI 1.52-2.31). Recent EVD information and formal EVD education were associated with higher knowledge scores. Knowledge was positively associated with the favorable-attitude score, and both were associated with intended-response scores; these primary patterns persisted in interviewer-clustered and bounded-outcome sensitivity analyses. Of all 788 consenting adults, 602 (76.4%) supported additional public EVD education. CONCLUSIONS: Approximately half of respondents had previously heard of EVD. Knowledge, attitude, current-behavior, and intended-response estimates apply only to those with prior awareness and must not be interpreted as community-wide measures or verified outbreak readiness. Findings identify communication priorities but do not establish causal relationships or predict behavior during an outbreak.

source_records.title: Virus
source_records.abstract: A critical, annotated version of Narlikar’s iconic novel about a cybervirus attack by an advanced alien species—with updated text and added material. A year before Robin Cook’s Invasion (1997)—in which an alien force activates a latent biological virus in humans—and almost a decade before Liu Cixin’s The Remembrance of Earth’s Past trilogy (2008–2010)—in which humanity’s scientific progress is curtailed by an alien supercomputer’s “sophon-lock”—Jayant Vishnu Narlikar’s Virus (1996) painted a similar scenario. In his novel, a cybervirus broadcast by an advanced, extraterrestrial species invades Earth and freezes its digital infrastructure: a prelude to an alien invasion. The novel, first published in Marathi, recounts how vast radio arrays on Earth intercept a seemingly innocuous message from an unknown planet orbiting Barnard’s Star. The radio signal, sent six years prior, coalesces into a cybervirus that has the potential to cause a complete digital meltdown and lead humanity into an age of chaos—an alien first strike to prevent humanity from evolving further. This book—a critical, annotated version of Virus, edited and revised by Sami Ahmad Khan—reissues Narlikar’s iconic novel with updated text and added dimensions. It includes detailed annotations that locate the technology of the text along the axis of contemporary scientific thought, as well as critical essays that focus on the literary, political, and sociocultural dimensions of the novel; essays on Narlikar’s role in India’s science and science fiction; an exclusive conversation with the author; bibliographical information on his works; and a bonus short story. Contributions by Sami Ahmad Khan, Nilam Ingole, Priteegandha Naik, Jayant V. Narlikar, and Dibyadyuti Roy.

papers.title: Ebola Virus Transmission and Prevention in Healthcare Settings: A Focused Review for Healthcare Professionals
papers.abstract: This focused review synthesizes current evidence on Ebola virus disease (EVD) transmission and infection prevention and control (IPC) measures within healthcare settings. Given its high mortality rate, potential for rapid spread, and the vulnerability of healthcare workers (HCWs), this review aims to clarify transmission pathways, highlight essential diagnostic and protective strategies, and integrate lessons from recent outbreaks, particularly the 2026 Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) epidemic. Evidence confirms that EVD transmission in healthcare facilities is driven primarily by direct contact with infected bodily fluids, with percutaneous injuries posing the highest risk. Viral persistence in semen, ocular fluid, and breast milk underscores ongoing transmission potential even after recovery. Updated WHO and CDC guidance emphasize rigorous personal protective equipment (PPE) use, safe injection practices, environmental decontamination, and strict isolation. The 2026 BDBV outbreak revealed new IPC challenges: delayed case detection due to nonspecific early symptoms, inadequate triage systems, limited diagnostic capacity for BDBV, and operational barriers, including insecurity and disrupted referral pathways. These gaps highlight the need for strengthened surveillance, decentralized testing, and continuous training of healthcare workers. EVD prevention in healthcare settings requires a multilayered IPC approach grounded in early identification, strict isolation, meticulous PPE use, safe clinical practices, and robust environmental management. Training, psychological support, and continuous monitoring of HCWs are essential for sustaining compliance. Preparedness must evolve through improved diagnostics, enhanced triage systems, and institutional commitment to IPC excellence. This review consolidates current evidence to support safer healthcare environments and reduce nosocomial transmission risks.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 这项重点综述综合了医疗机构内 埃博拉病毒病 (EVD) 传播 和感染预防和控制 (IPC) 措施的当前证据。鉴于 死亡率 的高发病率、快速传播的潜力以及医护人员 (HCW) 的脆弱性,本次综述旨在阐明 传播 途径,强调基本的诊断和保护策略,并整合最近的 暴发,特别是 2026 年本迪布焦埃博拉病毒 (BDBV) 流行的经验教训。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查包括最近 暴发 的证据,特别是 2026 年本迪布焦埃博拉病毒 (BDBV) 流行病,并整合了从这些事件中吸取的经验教训。证据证实,医疗机构中的埃博拉病毒病 传播 主要是由直接接触受感染的体液引起的,其中经皮损伤的风险最高。世卫组织和疾病预防控制中心更新的指南强调严格使用个人防护装备(PPE)、安全注射实践、环境净化和严格隔离。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 精液、眼液和母乳中病毒的持续存在凸显了 传播 即使在康复后仍具有持续的潜力。

papers.title: Early epidemiological and spatial assessment of the Bundibugyo virus outbreak 2026.
papers.abstract: A Bundibugyo virus outbreak was first reported on May 15th, 2026 in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with multiple cases reported across health zones during the early phase of the outbreak and suggestions of circulation weeks prior to detection. We pair highly resolved case and testing records with human mobility data to investigate the early outbreak dynamics of Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD). We show that human movement was a principle driver of early spatial expansion between May 10th and June 1st when the number of health zones and health areas reporting positive cases increased by 12 and 49, respectively. The early doubling time was estimated at ~10 days. Our work shows the rapid spatial expansion and growth of BVD with implications for intervention strategies.

papers.title: Construction of minigenomic replicon and infectious virus-like particle systems for Ebola virus with epitope-tagged L polymerase.
papers.abstract: Ebola virus (EBOV) L protein is the viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp) and a key antiviral target. Functional dissection of L during infection is hampered by scarce specific anti-L antibodies and mandatory BSL-4 containment for live EBOV. Here, we established two BSL-2 reverse genetic systems harboring tagged L protein to address these obstacles. First, we generated stable EBOV minigenomic replicon cells constitutively expressing NP, VP30, VP35 and TagL, supporting sustained viral minigenome replication. Second, we developed an infectious virus-like particle (iVLP) system in which an EBOV subgenome encoding GP, VP40 and VP24 replicates robustly in optimized TagL-expressing helper cells to generate fully infectious iVLPs, recapitulating the entire EBOV life cycle. Proteomic analysis of intact iVLPs and delipidated ribonucleoprotein (RNP) complexes uncovered a previously unrecognized association between EBOV RNP and cytoskeletal proteins. Pharmacological disruption of microtubules enhanced EBOV replication/transcription and virion production, providing new insights into virus-host interactions during EBOV infection. Collectively, these optimized TagL-integrated reverse genetics tools provide tractable BSL-2 tools to study EBOV L-RNP biology during the full viral life cycle.

papers.title_zh: 使用表位标记的 L 聚合酶构建 埃博拉病毒 的小型基因组复制子和感染性病毒样颗粒系统。
papers.source_body_en: Ebola virus (EBOV) L protein is the viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp) and a key antiviral target. papers.abstract_zh: 埃博拉病毒 (EBOV) L 蛋白是病毒 RNA 依赖性 RNA 聚合酶 (RdRp) 和 抗病毒药物 的关键靶标。感染期间 L 的功能性解剖受到稀缺的特异性抗 L 抗体和对活 EBOV 的强制 BSL-4 遏制的阻碍。在这里,我们建立了两个含有标记 L 蛋白的 BSL-2 反向遗传系统来解决这些障碍。首先,我们生成了稳定的 EBOV 小基因组复制子细胞,其组成型表达 NP、VP30、VP35 和 TagL,支持持续的病毒小基因组复制。其次,我们开发了一种感染性病毒样颗粒(iVLP)系统,其中编码 GP、VP40 和 VP24 的 EBOV 亚基因组在优化的表达 TagL 的辅助细胞中稳健复制,以产生完全感染性的 iVLP,从而概括了整个 EBOV 生命周期。对完整 iVLP 和脱脂核糖核蛋白 (RNP) 复合物的蛋白质组学分析揭示了 EBOV RNP 与细胞骨架蛋白之间以前未被认识的关联。微管的药理学破坏增强了 EBOV 复制/转录和病毒颗粒的产生,为 EBOV 感染期间病毒与 宿主 相互作用提供了新的见解。总的来说,这些优化的 TagL 集成反向遗传学工具为研究整个病毒生命周期中的 EBOV L-RNP 生物学提供了易于处理的 BSL-2 工具。

papers.title: Reverse Transcription Loop-Mediated Isothermal Amplification Combined with Lateral Flow Assay (RT-LAMP-LFA) for Rapid Detection of the 2026 Bundibugyo Virus (BDBV) Outbreak Strain
papers.abstract: Abstract Making accurate diagnosis is a critical first step in patient management and control for emerging and re-emerging disease outbreaks. Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) is a filovirus that causes Ebola disease, and the 2026 outbreak highlights the need for rapid diagnostic approaches that can be deployed in settings with limited laboratory infrastructure. Here, we developed a reverse transcription loop-mediated isothermal amplification–lateral flow assay (RT-LAMP-LFA) for rapid detection of the 2026 BDBV outbreak strain. LAMP primers were designed based on the genome sequence of the 2026 outbreak strain, and the conservation of the primer binding sites among all available 2026 outbreak genomes was confirmed in silico. LAMP primers were evaluated for analytical specificity and sensitivity using in vitro-transcribed RNA (ivtRNA) from BDBV and other filoviruses, as well as RNA derived from arboviruses and mammalian cells. Amplification products were detected using a Chromatography-Printed Array Strip (C-PAS) lateral flow platform. The newly designed primers specifically detected the presence of BDBV RNA without nonspecific amplification of the other viral or cellular RNA samples tested. Consistent amplification was observed down to 10 3 copies per reaction. In addition, BDBV viral RNA was successfully amplified, and the amplification products were detected using C-PAS, with the total workflow being completed within 25 min. These findings demonstrate the analytical specificity and sensitivity of the developed RT-LAMP-LFA assay and its compatibility with rapid visual lateral flow detection, supporting its potential application as a point-of-care approach for BDBV detection. Importance Bundibugyo virus causes a form of Ebola disease for which rapid and reliable diagnostic testing is essential to support outbreak response. However, molecular tests may require specialized equipment and laboratory infrastructure, limiting access to testing in remote or resource-limited settings. In this study, we developed a rapid molecular assay targeting the 2026 outbreak strain of Bundibugyo virus. The assay detected viral RNA at concentrations as low as 10 3 copies per reaction, showed no nonspecific amplification with the other viral and cellular RNA samples tested, and produced results using a visual detection platform within approximately 25 minutes, excluding sample preparation. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of a rapid and simplified approach for Bundibugyo virus detection. Further evaluation using clinical specimens and under field conditions is needed to establish its diagnostic performance and practical applicability.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 制定准确的 诊断 是新发和复发疾病 诊断 患者管理和控制的关键第一步。本迪布焦病毒 (BDBV) 是一种引起埃博拉疾病的丝状病毒,2026 暴发 强调需要可以在实验室基础设施有限的环境中部署快速诊断方法。在这里,我们开发了一种逆转录环介导的等温扩增侧流测定(RT-LAMP-LFA),用于快速检测 2026 BDBV 暴发 菌株。LAMP引物是根据2026 暴发菌株的基因组序列设计的,并在计算机上证实了所有可用的2026 暴发 基因组中引物结合位点的保守性。使用来自 BDBV 和其他丝状病毒的体外转录 RNA (ivtRNA) 以及源自虫媒病毒和哺乳动物细胞的 RNA 评估 LAMP 引物的分析特异性和灵敏度。使用色谱印刷阵列条 (C-PAS) 侧流平台检测扩增产物。新设计的引物专门检测 BDBV RNA 的存在,而不会非特异性扩增其他测试的病毒或细胞 RNA 样本。每个反应观察到一致的扩增,低至 10 3 个拷贝。此外,BDBV病毒RNA成功扩增,并使用C-PAS检测扩增产物,整个工作流程在25分钟内完成。这些发现证明了所开发的 RT-LAMP-LFA 测定的分析特异性和灵敏度及其与快速视觉侧流检测的兼容性,支持其作为 BDBV 检测的即时护理方法的潜在应用。重要性 本迪布焦病毒会引起一种埃博拉疾病,快速、可靠的诊断测试对于支持 暴发 应对至关重要。然而,分子测试可能需要专门的设备和实验室基础设施,从而限制了在偏远或资源有限的环境中进行测试。在这项研究中,我们开发了一种针对本迪布焦病毒 2026 暴发 株的快速分子检测方法。该测定检测到每个反应浓度低至 10 3 个拷贝的病毒 RNA,与测试的其他病毒和细胞 RNA 样品没有显示非特异性扩增,并使用视觉检测平台在大约 25 分钟内产生结果(不包括样品制备)。这些发现证明了快速且简化的本迪布焦病毒检测方法的可行性。需要使用临床标本和在现场条件下进行进一步评估,以确定其诊断性能和实际适用性。

papers.title: Doxycycline and Nitazoxanide as a Candidate Immunomodulatory Combination for the Early Management of Ebola Disease Caused by Bundibugyo Virus
papers.abstract: As of 11 November 2026, Bundibugyo virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo had produced 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 deaths, and in the latest WHO interval close to two of every three deaths were in communities, not treatment centres, especially among young children. No vaccine or treatment is approved for this species, and the agents in trials are monoclonal antibodies and direct-acting antivirals. In 2021, I proposed reclassifying COVID-19, Ebola virus disease and Nipah virus infection as a novel acute immune dysrhythmia syndrome. Read through it, the pathology described in Bundibugyo-infected macaques points to two arms: fatal animals showed myeloid hyperinflammation with raised interleukin-6 and myeloperoxidase, survivors showed transcripts consistent with an intact T cell response. Basing on that convergence I propose doxycycline and nitazoxanide as an early immunomodulatory combination, each on a different arm. Doxycycline inhibits matrix metalloproteinases at exposures achievable in man. Nitazoxanide amplifies RNA sensing and interferon signalling; its inhibition of Zaire ebolavirus in cell culture depends on RIG-I and PKR. However, none of this establishes efficacy in this disease. What it offers is a mechanism worth testing in two licensed, oral, inexpensive drugs on the shelf, the host-directed concentration unmeasured. I therefore ask for species-specific work to begin soonest: activity in relevant cells and in the macaque model, the unbound concentration-response relationship, and a two-by-two factorial evaluation, preclinical and clinical, powered for the interaction. For the patient who cannot reach a participating unit, I also call for monitored emergency use under the WHO framework, with every outcome recorded and reported. I strongly suggest that the search for safe immunomodulators is the one most likely to end in a drug available on the day it is needed.

analysis.research_question_and_background: As of 11 November 2026, Bundibugyo virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo had produced 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 deaths, with a high mortality rate in communities, especially among young children. No vaccine or treatment is approved for this species, and the agents in trials are monoclonal antibodies and direct-acting antivirals.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focuses on Bundibugyo virus disease and proposes doxycycline and nitazoxanide as a candidate immunomodulatory combination for the early management of the disease. The research is based on observations from Bundibugyo-infected macaques.
analysis.methods: The methods involve analyzing the pathology described in Bundibugyo-infected macaques, which points to two distinct arms: fatal animals showed myeloid hyperinflammation with raised interleukin-6 and myeloperoxidase, while survivors showed transcripts consistent with an intact T cell response.
analysis.main_results: The pathology described in Bundibugyo-infected macaques indicates that fatal cases showed myeloid hyperinflammation with elevated interleukin-6 and myeloperoxidase levels, whereas survivors exhibited transcripts consistent with an intact T cell response.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The author interprets the findings as suggesting that doxycycline and nitazoxanide could be used as an early immunomodulatory combination, targeting the two distinct arms of the disease observed in macaques.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings offer a mechanism for testing doxycycline and nitazoxanide as potential treatments for Bundibugyo virus disease, which could lead to the development of an available drug for emergency use.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on observations from macaques and does not establish efficacy in humans. It provides a hypothesis for further research but lacks direct clinical validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the need for effective treatments for Bundibugyo virus disease, which has caused significant morbidity and mortality in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The research highlights the lack of approved vaccines or treatments and proposes doxycycline and nitazoxanide as a potential immunomodulatory combination. Based on observations from infected macaques, the study identifies two distinct pathological arms: fatal cases show myeloid hyperinflammation with elevated interleukin-6 and myeloperoxidase, while survivors exhibit intact T cell responses. The author suggests that these drugs, which are already available, could be tested for their efficacy in the disease. However, the study does not provide direct evidence of their effectiveness in humans and calls for further research, including species-specific testing and a factorial evaluation. The findings are of scientific and public health significance as they offer a potential therapeutic approach for a disease with limited treatment options.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 截至 2026 年 11 月 11 日,刚果民主共和国的本迪布焦病毒病已造成 11,114 例确诊病例和 5,433 例死亡,社区尤其是幼儿中的 死亡率 发病率很高。疫苗 或 治疗 尚未获批用于该物种,试验中的药物为单克隆抗体和直接作用的 抗病毒药物。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究重点关注本迪布焦病毒病,并提出强力霉素和硝唑尼特作为该疾病早期治疗的候选免疫调节组合。该研究基于对感染本迪布焦的猕猴的观察。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法包括分析感染本迪布焦的猕猴的病理学,该病理学指向两个不同的分支:致命的动物表现出骨髓过度炎症,白介素 6 和髓过氧化物酶升高,而幸存者则表现出与完整 T 细胞反应一致的转录本。
elements_zh.main_results: 感染本迪布焦的猕猴的病理学表明,致命病例表现出骨髓过度炎症,白细胞介素 6 和髓过氧化物酶水平升高,而幸存者则表现出与完整 T 细胞反应一致的转录本。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为表明多西环素和硝唑尼特可以用作早期免疫调节组合,针对在猕猴中观察到的两种不同的疾病。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了一种测试多西环素和硝唑尼特作为本迪布焦病毒病潜在 治疗 的机制,这可能导致开发一种可供紧急使用的药物。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该证据基于对猕猴的观察,并未证实对人类有效。它为进一步研究提供了假设,但缺乏直接的临床验证。

papers.source_body_en: As of 11 November 2026, Bundibugyo virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo had produced 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 deaths, and in the latest WHO interval close to two of every three deaths were in communities, not treatment centres, especially among young children. No vaccine or treatment is approved for this species, and the agents in trials are monoclonal antibodies and direct-acting antivirals. In 2021, I proposed reclassifying COVID-19, Ebola virus disease and Nipah virus infection as a novel acute immune dysrhythmia syndrome. Read through it, the pathology described in Bundibugyo-infected macaques points to two arms: fatal animals showed myeloid hyperinflammation with raised interleukin-6 and myeloperoxidase, survivors showed transcripts consistent with an intact T cell response. Basing on that convergence I propose doxycycline and nitazoxanide as an early immunomodulatory combination, each on a different arm. Doxycycline inhibits matrix metalloproteinases at exposures achievable in man. Nitazoxanide amplifies RNA sensing and interferon signalling; its inhibition of Zaire ebolavirus in cell culture depends on RIG-I and PKR. However, none of this establishes efficacy in this disease. What it offers is a mechanism worth testing in two licensed, oral, inexpensive drugs on the shelf, the host-directed concentration unmeasured. I therefore ask for species-specific work to begin soonest: activity in relevant cells and in the macaque model, the unbound concentration-response relationship, and a two-by-two factorial evaluation, preclinical and clinical, powered for the interaction. For the patient who cannot reach a participating unit, I also call for monitored emergency use under the WHO framework, with every outcome recorded and reported. I strongly suggest that the search for safe immunomodulators is the one most likely to end in a drug available on the day it is needed.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 截至 2026 年 11 月 11 日,刚果民主共和国的本迪布焦病毒病已造成 11,114 例确诊病例和 5,433 例死亡,社区尤其是幼儿中的 死亡率 发病率很高。疫苗 或 治疗 尚未获批用于该物种,试验中的药物为单克隆抗体和直接作用的 抗病毒药物。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究重点关注本迪布焦病毒病,并提出强力霉素和硝唑尼特作为该疾病早期治疗的候选免疫调节组合。该研究基于对感染本迪布焦的猕猴的观察。
analysis_zh.methods: 这些方法包括分析感染本迪布焦的猕猴的病理学,该病理学指向两个不同的分支:致命的动物表现出骨髓过度炎症,白介素 6 和髓过氧化物酶升高,而幸存者则表现出与完整 T 细胞反应一致的转录本。
analysis_zh.main_results: 感染本迪布焦的猕猴的病理学表明,致命病例表现出骨髓过度炎症,白细胞介素 6 和髓过氧化物酶水平升高,而幸存者则表现出与完整 T 细胞反应一致的转录本。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为表明多西环素和硝唑尼特可以用作早期免疫调节组合,针对在猕猴中观察到的两种不同的疾病。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了一种测试多西环素和硝唑尼特作为本迪布焦病毒病潜在 治疗 的机制,这可能导致开发一种可供紧急使用的药物。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该证据基于对猕猴的观察,并未证实对人类有效。它为进一步研究提供了假设,但缺乏直接的临床验证。

papers.title: Marked Geographic Heterogeneity in Ebola Virus Disease Case Fatality During the 17th Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 2026: a Health Zone Level Funnel Plot Analysis
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The Ebola case fatality ratio (CFR) classically varies by geographic and operational context, but this heterogeneity has rarely been formally quantified sub-nationally in real time during an active outbreak. Methods From 142 situation reports (SitReps) (May 18 to October 3, 2026), we extracted confirmed cases/deaths for 64 health zones, calculated CFR with 95% Wilson confidence intervals, tested heterogeneity by chi-square, and visualised it by Spiegelhalter funnel plot, excluding a block of 493 unallocated Ituri deaths from zone/province analyses ; sensitivity analyses tested four alternative ways of handling these deaths. Results Zone-summed CFR ranged from 33.3% (South Kivu) to 58.5% (North Kivu, 95% CI 56.1–60.8), via 38.3% in Ituri (95% CI 37.1–39.5); heterogeneity was highly significant (x 2 = 227.1, df = 6, p < 0.001) and persisted within Ituri (13 zones, x 2 = 193.5, df = 12, p < 0.001). The funnel plot flagged five zones above the 99.8% control limit (Komanda and Nia-Nia in Ituri; Beni, Butembo and Katwa in North Kivu) and five Ituri zones below it. The Ituri–North Kivu gap narrowed from ~ 29 points (late August) to 20.2 points (October 3), a real but modest convergence driven by North Kivu's decline. When the 493 unallocated deaths were added to Ituri, the gap on October 3 was 12.6 points, and the convergence remained driven by North Kivu. Conclusions Case fatality shows robust, persisting geographic heterogeneity at two scales, with a real but limited inter-provincial convergence since September, warranting targeted investigation of treatment-capacity and care-seeking determinants.

papers.title_zh: 2026 年刚果民主共和国第 17 届 埃博拉病毒病 病死率存在明显的地理异质性:卫生区级别漏斗图分析
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background The Ebola case fatality ratio (CFR) classically varies by geographic and operational context, but this heterogeneity has rarely been formally quantified sub-nationally in real time during an active outbreak. Methods From 142 situation reports (SitReps) (May 18 to October 3, 2026), we extracted confirmed cases/deaths for 64 health zones, calculated CFR with 95% Wilson confidence intervals, tested heterogeneity by chi-square, and visualised it by Spiegelhalter funnel plot, excluding a block of 493 unallocated Ituri deaths from zone/province analyses ; sensitivity analyses tested four alternative ways of handling these deaths. Results Zone-summed CFR ranged from 33.3% (South Kivu) to 58.5% (North Kivu, 95% CI 56.1–60.8), via 38.3% in Ituri (95% CI 37.1–39.5); heterogeneity was highly significant (x 2 = 227.1, df = 6, p < 0.001) and persisted within Ituri (13 zones, x 2 = 193.5, df = 12, p < 0.001). The funnel plot flagged five zones above the 99.8% control limit (Komanda and Nia-Nia in Ituri; Beni, Butembo and Katwa in North Kivu) and five Ituri zones below it. The Ituri–North Kivu gap narrowed from ~ 29 points (late August) to 20.2 points (October 3), a real but modest convergence driven by North Kivu's decline. When the 493 unallocated deaths were added to Ituri, the gap on October 3 was 12.6 points, and the convergence remained driven by North Kivu. Conclusions Case fatality shows robust, persisting geographic heterogeneity at two scales, with a real but limited inter-provincial convergence since September, warranting targeted investigation of treatment-capacity and care-seeking determinants.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 埃博拉病死率 (CFR) 通常会因地理和操作环境而异,但在 暴发 活跃期间,这种异质性很少在全国范围内实时正式量化。方法 从 142 份情况报告 (SitReps)(2026 年 5 月 18 日至 10 月 3 日)中,我们提取了 64 个卫生区的确诊病例/死亡病例,使用 95% Wilson 置信区间计算 CFR,通过卡方检验异质性,并通过 Spiegelhalter 漏斗图将其可视化,排除区域/省分析中 493 例未分配的伊图里死亡病例;敏感性分析测试了处理这些死亡的四种替代方法。结果 区域总 CFR 范围为 33.3%(南基伍)至 58.5%(北基伍,95% CI 56.1–60.8),伊图里为 38.3%(95% CI 37.1–39.5);异质性非常显着(x 2 = 227.1,df = 6,p < 0.001),并且在伊图里持续存在(13 个区域,x 2 = 193.5,df = 12,p < 0.001)。漏斗图标记了高于 99.8% 控制限值的 5 个区域(伊图里的 Komanda 和 Nia-Nia;北基伍省的 Beni、Butembo 和 Katwa)以及低于 99.8% 控制限值的 5 个伊图里区域。伊图里与北基伍的差距从约 29 点(8 月下旬)缩小到 20.2 点(10 月 3 日),这是由于北基伍的下降所推动的真正但适度的趋同。当伊图里新增 493 例未分配死亡病例时,10 月 3 日的差距为 12.6 个百分点,趋同仍然是由北基伍省推动的。结论 病例死亡率在两个尺度上显示出强烈、持续的地理异质性,自 9 月份以来,省际间的趋同确实但有限,需要对 治疗 能力和就医决定因素进行有针对性的调查。

papers.title: Situation Analysis of the 17th Ebola Disease Outbreak Caused by Bundibugyo Virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Feasibility and Acceptability of a Ring-Based Infection-Prevention and -Control Approach
papers.abstract: Background: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has extensive experience responding to Ebola disease outbreaks; however, the emergence of Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) presents distinct operational challenges because its epidemiological evidence base and the available medical countermeasures are more limited than those for Zaire ebolavirus. The 2026 outbreak has been characterized by substantial transmission in Ituri Province, with reported activity in additional provinces. Operational challenges include incomplete contact follow-up, community deaths, health-system constraints, population mobility, insecurity and gaps in infection prevention and control (IPC). These challenges highlight the need for an adaptable framework that links case investigation, surveillance, IPC and community engagement. Objective: To describe the epidemiological and operational situation of the 2026 BDBV outbreak and develop a conceptual ring-oriented surveillance and IPC framework for organizing outbreak-response activities in Ituri Province, informed by evidence from previous Ebola outbreaks. Methods: A secondary descriptive situation analysis was undertaken using the outbreak situation report for the reporting period ending 11 August 2026, supplemented by a targeted narrative review of the published literature and relevant Ebola outbreak-response guidance. The reported indicators were descriptively summarized, including cases, deaths, alerts, laboratory testing, contact identification and follow-up, IPC activities and population-mobility surveillance. A conceptual Ring 0–Ring 5 framework was developed based on epidemiological proximity and operational connectivity. Ring 0 represents the suspected or confirmed case and immediate care environment; Ring 1 represents direct contacts; Ring 2 represents contacts of contacts and epidemiologically linked exposures; Ring 3 represents high-risk community settings; Ring 4 represents health-system and population-mobility interfaces; and Ring 5 represents regional and cross-border preparedness. The framework incorporates continuous monitoring with escalation, de-escalation or closure according to emerging epidemiological information. Results: By 11 August 2026, the situation report documented 4566 confirmed cases and 2128 confirmed deaths, with 3912 cases (85.7%) reported from Ituri. During the preceding 24 h reporting period, 118 new confirmed cases and 67 deaths were reported. Nationally, 20,728 contacts were identified and 17,085 followed (82.4%). A total of 1542 alerts were received, 1423 verified and 324 classified as suspected cases; 516 specimens were analysed, including 118 positive results. The proposed framework organizes these reported activities sequentially from case detection and immediate IPC (Ring 0), direct-contact investigation and monitoring (Ring 1), linked-exposure surveillance (Ring 2), community-level IPC and engagement (Ring 3), health-system and mobility surveillance (Ring 4), to regional and cross-border preparedness (Ring 5). Continuous epidemiological reassessment provides feedback for intensifying, expanding, de-escalating or closing response activities. Conclusions: The 2026 BDBV outbreak demonstrates the need for coordinated surveillance, case investigation, contact monitoring, IPC, clinical referral, safe and dignified burial, community engagement and health-system preparedness. The proposed ring-oriented surveillance and IPC framework provides a structured and adaptable approach for linking these activities according to epidemiological risk and operational connectivity. However, the present analysis is descriptive and conceptual and does not establish the effectiveness, feasibility or acceptability of the framework. Prospective implementation research is required to evaluate feasibility, acceptability, implementation fidelity and epidemiological effectiveness.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 鉴于与扎伊尔埃博拉病毒相比,流行病学证据和医疗对策有限,该研究旨在解决刚果民主共和国本迪布焦病毒引起的第17次埃博拉疫情暴发的操作挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用截至 2026 年 8 月 11 日的 暴发 情况报告进行了二次描述性情况分析,重点关注刚果民主共和国,特别是伊图里省的 2026 年 BDBV 暴发。
elements_zh.methods: 该分析涉及对已发表文献和相关埃博拉 暴发 应对指南进行有针对性的叙述性审查,同时对病例、死亡、警报、实验室检测、接触者识别和随访、IPC 活动和人口流动 监测 等报告指标进行描述性摘要。
elements_zh.main_results: 截至 2026 年 8 月 11 日,情况报告记录了 4566 例确诊病例和 2128 例确诊死亡,其中伊图里报告了 3912 例病例(85.7%)。在此前24小时报告期内,报告新增确诊病例118例,死亡67例。在全国范围内,已识别出 20,728 名接触者,并追踪了 17,085 名接触者 (82.4%)。共收到警报1542起,核实1423起,疑似病例324起;对 516 份样本进行了分析,其中 118 份呈阳性结果。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调需要一个将案件调查、监测、IPC 和社区参与联系起来的适应性框架,因为 暴发 期间观察到的操作挑战凸显了当前应对策略的局限性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 拟议的框架可以为协调 监测、病例调查、接触者监测、IPC、临床转诊、安全和有尊严的埋葬、社区参与和卫生系统为本迪布焦病毒和其他 埃博拉病毒 的未来 暴发 做好准备提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 目前的分析是描述性和概念性的,并没有确定该框架的有效性、可行性或可接受性。需要进行前瞻性实施研究来评估这些方面。

Operational challenges include incomplete contact follow-up, community deaths, health-system constraints, population mobility, insecurity and gaps in infection prevention and control (IPC). These challenges highlight the need for an adaptable framework that links case investigation, surveillance, IPC and community engagement. Objective: To describe the epidemiological and operational situation of the 2026 BDBV outbreak and develop a conceptual ring-oriented surveillance and IPC framework for organizing outbreak-response activities in Ituri Province, informed by evidence from previous Ebola outbreaks. Methods: A secondary descriptive situation analysis was undertaken using the outbreak situation report for the reporting period ending 11 August 2026, supplemented by a targeted narrative review of the published literature and relevant Ebola outbreak-response guidance. The reported indicators were descriptively summarized, including cases, deaths, alerts, laboratory testing, contact identification and follow-up, IPC activities and population-mobility surveillance. A conceptual Ring 0–Ring 5 framework was developed based on epidemiological proximity and operational connectivity. Ring 0 represents the suspected or confirmed case and immediate care environment; Ring 1 represents direct contacts; Ring 2 represents contacts of contacts and epidemiologically linked exposures; Ring 3 represents high-risk community settings; Ring 4 represents health-system and population-mobility interfaces; and Ring 5 represents regional and cross-border preparedness. The framework incorporates continuous monitoring with escalation, de-escalation or closure according to emerging epidemiological information. Results: By 11 August 2026, the situation report documented 4566 confirmed cases and 2128 confirmed deaths, with 3912 cases (85.7%) reported from Ituri. During the preceding 24 h reporting period, 118 new confirmed cases and 67 deaths were reported. Nationally, 20,728 contacts were identified and 17,085 followed (82.4%). A total of 1542 alerts were received, 1423 verified and 324 classified as suspected cases; 516 specimens were analysed, including 118 positive results. The proposed framework organizes these reported activities sequentially from case detection and immediate IPC (Ring 0), direct-contact investigation and monitoring (Ring 1), linked-exposure surveillance (Ring 2), community-level IPC and engagement (Ring 3), health-system and mobility surveillance (Ring 4), to regional and cross-border preparedness (Ring 5). Continuous epidemiological reassessment provides feedback for intensifying, expanding, de-escalating or closing response activities. Conclusions: The 2026 BDBV outbreak demonstrates the need for coordinated surveillance, case investigation, contact monitoring, IPC, clinical referral, safe and dignified burial, community engagement and health-system preparedness. The proposed ring-oriented surveillance and IPC framework provides a structured and adaptable approach for linking these activities according to epidemiological risk and operational connectivity. However, the present analysis is descriptive and conceptual and does not establish the effectiveness, feasibility or acceptability of the framework. Prospective implementation research is required to evaluate feasibility, acceptability, implementation fidelity and epidemiological effectiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:刚果民主共和国(DRC)在应对埃博拉疾病暴发方面拥有丰富的经验;然而,本迪布焦病毒(BDBV)的出现带来了明显的操作挑战,因为其流行病学证据基础和可用的医疗对策比扎伊尔埃博拉病毒更为有限。2026 年 暴发 的特点是伊图里省出现大量 传播,据报告其他省份也有活动。运营挑战包括接触者追踪不完整、社区死亡、卫生系统限制、人口流动、不安全以及感染预防和控制 (IPC) 方面的差距。这些挑战凸显了对将案件调查、监测、IPC 和社区参与联系起来的适应性框架的需求。目标:描述 2026 年 BDBV 暴发 的流行病学和操作情况,并根据之前埃博拉 暴发 的证据,制定一个面向环的概念 暴发 和 IPC 框架,用于在伊图里省组织 暴发 应对活动。方法:使用截至 2026 年 8 月 11 日的报告期的 暴发 情况报告进行了二次描述性情况分析,并辅以对已发表文献和相关埃博拉 暴发 应对指南的有针对性的叙述性审查。对报告的指标进行了描述性总结,包括病例、死亡、警报、实验室检测、接触者识别和随访、IPC 活动和人口流动 监测。基于流行病学邻近性和操作连通性,开发了概念性 0 环至 5 环框架。环0代表疑似或确诊病例和即时护理环境;环1代表直接接触;环2代表接触者的接触者和流行病学相关的暴露;环3代表高风险社区环境;环 4 代表卫生系统和人口流动接口;5 环代表区域和跨境准备。该框架包括根据新出现的流行病学信息进行持续监测、升级、降级或关闭。结果:截至 2026 年 8 月 11 日,情况报告记录了 4566 例确诊病例和 2128 例确诊死亡,其中伊图里报告了 3912 例病例(85.7%)。在此前24小时报告期内,报告新增确诊病例118例,死亡67例。在全国范围内,已识别出 20,728 名接触者,并追踪了 17,085 名接触者 (82.4%)。共收到警报1542起,核实1423起,疑似病例324起;对 516 份样本进行了分析,其中 118 份呈阳性结果。拟议的框架按顺序组织这些报告的活动,从病例检测和立即 IPC(环 0)、直接接触调查和监测(环 1)、关联暴露 监测(环 2)、社区级 IPC 和参与(环 3)、卫生系统和流动性 监测(环 4)到区域和跨境准备(环 5)。持续的流行病学重新评估为加强、扩大、降级或结束应对活动提供反馈。结论:2026 年 BDBV 暴发 表明需要协调 监测、病例调查、接触者监测、IPC、临床转诊、安全和有尊严的埋葬、社区参与和卫生系统准备。拟议的面向环的 监测 和 IPC 框架提供了一种结构化且适应性强的方法,用于根据流行病学风险和操作连通性链接这些活动。然而,目前的分析是描述性和概念性的,并没有确定该框架的有效性、可行性或可接受性。需要进行前瞻性实施研究来评估可行性、可接受性、实施保真度和流行病学有效性。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 鉴于与扎伊尔埃博拉病毒相比,流行病学证据和医疗对策有限,该研究旨在解决刚果民主共和国本迪布焦病毒引起的第17次埃博拉疫情暴发的操作挑战。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用截至 2026 年 8 月 11 日的 暴发 情况报告进行了二次描述性情况分析,重点关注刚果民主共和国,特别是伊图里省的 2026 年 BDBV 暴发。
analysis_zh.methods: 该分析涉及对已发表文献和相关埃博拉 暴发 应对指南进行有针对性的叙述性审查,同时对病例、死亡、警报、实验室检测、接触者识别和随访、IPC 活动和人口流动 监测 等报告指标进行描述性摘要。
analysis_zh.main_results: 截至 2026 年 8 月 11 日,情况报告记录了 4566 例确诊病例和 2128 例确诊死亡,其中伊图里报告了 3912 例病例(85.7%)。在此前24小时报告期内,报告新增确诊病例118例,死亡67例。在全国范围内,已识别出 20,728 名接触者,并追踪了 17,085 名接触者 (82.4%)。共收到警报1542起,核实1423起,疑似病例324起;对 516 份样本进行了分析,其中 118 份呈阳性结果。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调需要一个将案件调查、监测、IPC 和社区参与联系起来的适应性框架,因为 暴发 期间观察到的操作挑战凸显了当前应对策略的局限性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 拟议的框架可以为协调 监测、病例调查、接触者监测、IPC、临床转诊、安全和有尊严的埋葬、社区参与和卫生系统为本迪布焦病毒和其他 埃博拉病毒 的未来 暴发 做好准备提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 目前的分析是描述性和概念性的,并没有确定该框架的有效性、可行性或可接受性。需要进行前瞻性实施研究来评估这些方面。

papers.title: A comprehensive Ebola virus–human protein interactome generated by AP-MS and proximity labeling MS
papers.abstract: Ebola virus (EBOV) is a highly pathogenic agent that causes severe hemorrhagic fever in a wide range of mammalian species. Its high mortality rate underscores the urgent need to elucidate the molecular mechanisms governing its life cycle. The development of effective antivirals and vaccines relies on a comprehensive understanding of the molecular basis underlying viral pathogenesis. To this end, a combination of affinity purification (AP) and proximity labeling (PL), coupled with mass spectrometry (MS), was employed to construct a comprehensive protein interactome between EBOV and the human host. This interactome comprises 6,868 interactions involving nine EBOV proteins and 2,643 human interactors. This interactome offers a resource of potential host factors and therapeutic targets, providing a foundation for future mechanistic and therapeutic studies aimed at identifying candidate host factors and pathways.

papers.source_body_en: Ebola virus (EBOV) is a highly pathogenic agent that causes severe hemorrhagic fever in a wide range of mammalian species. Its high mortality rate underscores the urgent need to elucidate the molecular mechanisms governing its life cycle. The development of effective antivirals and vaccines relies on a comprehensive understanding of the molecular basis underlying viral pathogenesis. To this end, a combination of affinity purification (AP) and proximity labeling (PL), coupled with mass spectrometry (MS), was employed to construct a comprehensive protein interactome between EBOV and the human host. This interactome comprises 6,868 interactions involving nine EBOV proteins and 2,643 human interactors. This interactome offers a resource of potential host factors and therapeutic targets, providing a foundation for future mechanistic and therapeutic studies aimed at identifying candidate host factors and pathways.

papers.title: Endogenous anti-Ebola virus GP 1,2 antibodies interfere with detection of secreted glycoprotein in the blood of EVD patients
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Ebola disease (EBOD) is a highly infectious disease with severe hemorrhagic symptoms. It is caused by orthoebolaviruses , which include the Ebola virus ( Orthoebolavirus zairense ) (EBOV) causing Ebola virus disease (EVD), the most lethal EBOD to humans. Through co-transcriptional polymerase stuttering and subsequent proteolytic processing, its GP gene produces multiple protein products, including secreted glycoprotein (sGP) and structural membrane-associated trimeric GP 1,2 . Although sGP is known to circulate in the blood, its physiological significance in disease pathology remains speculative. We quantified sGP using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) in 36 acute human EVD cases from the 10th and 11th EVD outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) using single-time-point biobanked samples. We detected and quantified sGP in four patients with strong GP gene transcription (GP Ct 1,2 IgG. However, sGP was not quantified in patients with lower GP transcription (Ct > 25), regardless of their anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG results. While two patients, MAM179 and MAM271, had notably strong GP transcription (Ct 1,2 IgG might have interfered with detection by the assay detection antibody, a human anti-EBOV GP 1,2 /sGP IgG. Furthermore, the addition of sera containing anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG reduced the binding between sGP and anti-EBOV GP 1,2 /sGP used as detection antibodies. This suggested that the level of sGP in circulation is strongly linked to the intensity of GP transcription. Additionally, circulating sGP in this context would form complexes with anti-GP 1,2 antibodies, hence hindering additional antibody binding for detection. IMPORTANCE Insight into the mechanism of immune function by the Ebola virus secreted glycoprotein (sGP) in humans is essential for better understanding viral pathogenesis, immune protection, and immune evasion strategies. Research utilizing samples from patients who are infected with or have survived infection with the Ebola virus offers an unparalleled opportunity to determine the immunological significance of sGP. This research evaluates, in acutely infected patients from Ebola virus disease outbreaks, the role of EBOV sGP in modulating antibody responses directed against viral entry glycoprotein. By elucidating how sGP influences antibody-mediated immunity, the study advances our understanding of a conserved immune-evasion mechanism shared across all orthoebolaviruses. These investigations are valuable resources for designing more efficacious vaccines, therapies, and biomarkers for monitoring Ebola virus diseases.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the role of endogenous anti-Ebola virus GP 1,2 antibodies in interfering with the detection of secreted glycoprotein (sGP) in the blood of Ebola virus disease (EVD) patients, as understanding this mechanism is essential for better comprehension of viral pathogenesis and immune evasion strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed 36 acute human EVD cases from the 10th and 11th EVD outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo using single-time-point biobanked samples. It focused on patients with varying levels of GP transcription, particularly those with strong GP gene transcription (GP Ct 1,2 IgG) and those with lower GP transcription (Ct > 25).
analysis.methods: sGP was quantified using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) in biobanked samples from EVD patients. The study also tested the effect of sera containing anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG on the binding between sGP and detection antibodies.
analysis.main_results: sGP was detected and quantified in four patients with strong GP transcription (GP Ct 1,2 IgG). However, sGP was not quantified in patients with lower GP transcription (Ct > 25), regardless of their anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG results. The addition of sera containing anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG reduced the binding between sGP and detection antibodies.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the presence of anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG may interfere with the detection of sGP, indicating a potential mechanism by which sGP modulates antibody responses. This provides novel insights into immune evasion strategies of orthoebolaviruses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results are valuable for improving the design of vaccines, therapies, and biomarkers for monitoring Ebola virus diseases, as they highlight the challenges in detecting sGP and its implications for immune responses.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on single-time-point biobanked samples, which may not capture dynamic changes in sGP levels. The evidence is moderate, as the findings are based on observational data and not experimental manipulation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the interference of endogenous anti-Ebola virus GP 1,2 antibodies with the detection of secreted glycoprotein (sGP) in the blood of patients with Ebola virus disease (EVD). Using ELISA, sGP was quantified in 36 acute EVD cases from the 10th and 11th outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Results showed that sGP was detectable in patients with strong GP transcription but not in those with lower transcription levels. The study also found that sera containing anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG reduced the binding between sGP and detection antibodies, suggesting a potential mechanism for immune evasion. These findings highlight the challenges in detecting sGP and its role in modulating antibody responses, offering insights for vaccine and diagnostic development. However, the study's reliance on single-time-point samples limits its generalizability, and the evidence is considered moderate due to the observational nature of the results.

papers.title_zh: 内源性抗 埃博拉病毒 GP 1,2 抗体干扰 EVD 患者血液中分泌糖蛋白的检测
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Ebola disease (EBOD) is a highly infectious disease with severe hemorrhagic symptoms. It is caused by orthoebolaviruses , which include the Ebola virus ( Orthoebolavirus zairense ) (EBOV) causing Ebola virus disease (EVD), the most lethal EBOD to humans. Through co-transcriptional polymerase stuttering and subsequent proteolytic processing, its GP gene produces multiple protein products, including secreted glycoprotein (sGP) and structural membrane-associated trimeric GP 1,2 . Although sGP is known to circulate in the blood, its physiological significance in disease pathology remains speculative. We quantified sGP using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) in 36 acute human EVD cases from the 10th and 11th EVD outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) using single-time-point biobanked samples. We detected and quantified sGP in four patients with strong GP gene transcription (GP Ct 1,2 IgG. However, sGP was not quantified in patients with lower GP transcription (Ct > 25), regardless of their anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG results. While two patients, MAM179 and MAM271, had notably strong GP transcription (Ct 1,2 IgG might have interfered with detection by the assay detection antibody, a human anti-EBOV GP 1,2 /sGP IgG. Furthermore, the addition of sera containing anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG reduced the binding between sGP and anti-EBOV GP 1,2 /sGP used as detection antibodies. This suggested that the level of sGP in circulation is strongly linked to the intensity of GP transcription. Additionally, circulating sGP in this context would form complexes with anti-GP 1,2 antibodies, hence hindering additional antibody binding for detection. IMPORTANCE Insight into the mechanism of immune function by the Ebola virus secreted glycoprotein (sGP) in humans is essential for better understanding viral pathogenesis, immune protection, and immune evasion strategies. Research utilizing samples from patients who are infected with or have survived infection with the Ebola virus offers an unparalleled opportunity to determine the immunological significance of sGP. This research evaluates, in acutely infected patients from Ebola virus disease outbreaks, the role of EBOV sGP in modulating antibody responses directed against viral entry glycoprotein. By elucidating how sGP influences antibody-mediated immunity, the study advances our understanding of a conserved immune-evasion mechanism shared across all orthoebolaviruses. These investigations are valuable resources for designing more efficacious vaccines, therapies, and biomarkers for monitoring Ebola virus diseases.

papers.title: What Ebola rumors are about: protocol for an integrative review of rumor accounts and response documents in Ebola disease outbreaks, 1995–2026
papers.abstract: This project holds the protocol, data, code and supporting materials for a critical integrative review titled “What Ebola rumors are about: an integrative review of rumor accounts and response documents in Ebola disease outbreaks, 1995–2026.” Purpose. Ebola response guidance often treats a rumor as false information to be corrected with a message. Many claims recorded during outbreaks, however, concern the response itself. Examples are treatment centers, burial teams, blood samples, vaccines and the use of response funds. A message alone cannot answer a claim about what a team did. No earlier review had counted what recorded Ebola rumors were about across outbreaks. None had compared that record with what response guidance tells responders to do. The review addresses five questions: what sources called the claims they recorded what types of rumor recurred what events and conditions sources connected to each type what harm followed each type how responses tried to counter rumors, and what limited them Methods. The review combines a purposive search of reference lists, repositories and the web with a reproducible search of six bibliographic databases. It covers outbreaks of Ebola, Sudan and Bundibugyo virus disease from 1995 to 2026. Two investigators independently screened every record and extracted and coded every rumor account. They also appraised every source with tools matched to its design. Each account was classified by the object of the claim: the disease, the conduct of the response, or the interests behind the outbreak or the response. Guidance documents were analyzed for how they define rumor and where they send it for handling. The review delivers: a typology of Ebola rumor drawn from 27 outbreak settings an account of what gave rise to each type of rumor and what followed it a comparison of the recorded claims with response guidance a six-step procedure for sending each type of claim to the part of the response that can investigate and answer it The findings are intended for response teams, rumor trackers, national public health agencies and the authors of response guidance. They are especially relevant to the 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease epidemic. The project contains the protocol, codebook and decision rules, and the complete dataset, which holds every search record, screening decision, account, code and appraisal judgment. It also contains the Python code that reproduces the main counts and agreement statistics from the dataset. Investigators: Eric Nzirakaindi Ikoona, Lucy Namulemo, Ronald Kaluya, Rebecca Sakwa and Foday Sahr.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查 暴发 期间埃博拉谣言的性质和内容以及应对指南如何解决这些谣言,因为之前没有任何评论系统地分析了不同 暴发 期间记录的埃博拉谣言的内容。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是对1995年至2026年埃博拉、苏丹和本迪布焦病毒病暴发的综合回顾,重点关注2026年本迪布焦病毒病疫情。它包括对参考文献列表、存储库和网络的有目的地搜索,以及对六个书目数据库的可重复搜索。
elements_zh.methods: 两名调查人员独立筛选了每一条记录,并对每条谣言进行了提取和编码。他们还使用与其设计相匹配的工具评估每个来源,并且每个帐户都根据声明的对象进行分类:疾病、响应的行为或 暴发 或响应背后的利益。
elements_zh.main_results: 该评论提供了从 27 个 暴发 设置中提取的埃博拉谣言的类型、对每种类型谣言的产生原因及其后续情况的说明、记录的声明与响应指南的比较,以及将每种类型的声明发送到可以调查和答复的响应部分的六步程序。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,这些发现为响应团队、谣言追踪者、国家公共卫生机构和指南作者提供了一种有效应对谣言的结构化方法,因为之前没有任何工作以这种方式将记录的声明与响应指南进行比较。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为制定有针对性的策略来管理埃博拉 暴发 期间的谣言提供信息,从而改善公共卫生应对措施与社区主张性质之间的一致性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对现有记录的依赖以及对谣言帐户进行主观分类的潜力而受到限制,但由于用于收集和分析数据的系统性和可重复性方法,证据是强有力的。

papers.abstract_zh: 该项目拥有用于关键综合审查的协议、数据、代码和支持材料,标题为“埃博拉谣言是关于什么的:对埃博拉疾病 暴发,1995-2026 年谣言描述和应对文件的综合审查”。目的。埃博拉应对指南通常将谣言视为需要通过消息纠正的虚假信息。然而,暴发 期间记录的许多声明都与响应本身有关。例如 治疗 中心、埋葬团队、血液样本、疫苗 以及应对资金的使用。仅一条消息无法回答有关团队所做工作的声明。之前的评论没有统计过 暴发 上记录的埃博拉谣言的内容。没有人将该记录与响应指南告诉响应者要做的事情进行比较。该评论解决了五个问题:哪些消息来源称其记录了哪些类型的谣言重复出现,与每种类型相关的事件和条件来源,每种类型会带来哪些危害,如何应对谣言,以及哪些限制了谣言的方法。该审查结合了对参考文献列表、存储库和网络的有目的地搜索以及对六个书目数据库的可重复搜索。它涵盖了1995年至2026年埃博拉、苏丹和本迪布焦病毒病的暴发。两名调查员独立筛选了每一条记录,并对每条谣言进行了提取和编码。他们还使用与其设计相匹配的工具评估每个来源。每个帐户均按索赔对象进行分类:疾病、响应行为或 暴发 或响应背后的利益。对指导文件进行了分析,了解它们如何定义谣言以及将谣言发送到何处进行处理。该评论提供了: 从 27 个 暴发 设置中提取的埃博拉谣言的类型 对每种谣言的产生原因及其后续情况进行说明 将记录的声明与响应指南进行比较 将每种类型的声明发送到可以调查和回答的响应部分的六步程序 这些调查结果适用于响应团队、谣言追踪者、国家公共卫生机构和响应指南的作者。它们与 2026 年本迪布焦病毒病的流行尤其相关。该项目包含协议、密码本和决策规则,以及完整的数据集,其中包含每条搜索记录、筛选决策、账户、代码和评估判断。它还包含从数据集中重现主要计数和一致性统计数据的 Python 代码。调查员:埃里克·恩齐拉坎迪·伊库纳、露西·纳穆莱莫、罗纳德·卡卢亚、丽贝卡·萨夸和福迪·萨尔。

papers.title: Ancestral state reconstruction with discrete characters using deep learning.
papers.abstract: Ancestral state reconstruction is a classical problem of broad relevance in phylogenetics. Likelihood-based methods for reconstructing ancestral states under discrete character models, such as Markov models and state-dependent speciation-extinction models, have proven extremely useful, but only work so long as the assumed model yields a tractable likelihood function. Unfortunately, extending a simple but tractable phylogenetic model to possess new, but biologically realistic, properties often results in an intractable likelihood, preventing its use in standard modeling tasks, including ancestral state reconstruction. The rapid advancement of deep learning offers a potential alternative to likelihood-based inference of ancestral states, particularly for models with intractable likelihoods. In this study, we modify the phylogenetic deep learning software phyddle to conduct ancestral state reconstruction. We evaluate phyddle's performance under various methodological and modeling conditions, while comparing to Bayesian inference when possible. For simple Markov models and small trees, its performance resembles the performance of Bayesian inference, but worsens as tree size increases. While phyddle still performs adequately for more complex models, such as state-dependent speciation-extinction models, the estimates differ more from Bayesian inference in comparison with simpler models. Lastly, we use phyddle to infer ancestral states for two empirical datasets, one of the ancestral ranges of a subclade of the genus Liolaemus and ancestral locations for sequences from the 2014 Sierra Leone Ebola virus disease outbreak.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究评估了 phyddle(一种改进的系统发育深度学习软件)在各种方法和建模条件下的性能。It compared phyddle's results to Bayesian inference when possible.经验数据集包括 Liolaemus 属一个分支的祖先范围和 2014 年塞拉利昂 埃博拉病毒病 暴发 序列的祖先位置。

elements_zh.main_results: 对于简单的马尔可夫模型和小树,其性能类似于贝叶斯推理的性能,但随着树大小的增加而恶化。虽然 phyddle 对于更复杂的模型(例如依赖于状态的物种形成灭绝模型)仍然表现良好,但与更简单的模型相比,估计值与贝叶斯推理的差异更大。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为祖先状态重建新方法的开发提供信息,这可能会提高对病毒 进化 和 流行病学 的理解。这可能对 监测 和病毒 暴发 的风险评估产生影响。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,深度学习为基于可能性的祖先状态推断提供了一种潜在的替代方案,特别是对于具有棘手可能性的模型。这项研究介绍了一种利用深度学习重建祖先状态的新方法。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为祖先状态重建新方法的开发提供信息,这可能会提高对病毒 进化 和 流行病学 的理解。这可能对 监测 和病毒 暴发 的风险评估产生影响。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的性能评估仅限于特定模型和树大小,结果可能无法推广到所有系统发育场景。证据是中等的,因为该研究将 phyddle 与贝叶斯推理进行了比较,但没有提供跨不同数据集的广泛验证。

papers.title: Computational Design and Biophysical Evaluation of VC032: A Multi-Epitope Vaccine Candidate Targeting Four Human-Pathogenic Orthoebolaviruses
papers.abstract: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD), caused by four human-pathogenic Orthoebolavirus species (Bundibugyo, Sudan, Taï Forest, and Zaire ebolaviruses), presents severe mortality (40%–90%). Licensed vaccines confer protection exclusively against Zaire ebolavirus, leaving persistent vulnerabilities against heterologous species due to 30%–40% envelope glycoprotein divergence. To address this, we executed proteome-wide immunoinformatics screening across 20,723 viral sequences encompassing seven structural and non-structural proteins. Multi-tier filtering for MHC restriction, conservancy, non-allergenicity, and human proteome non-homology identified 24 conserved epitopes across five viral targets (GP, VP35, VP24, L-polymerase, NP). From a combinatorial screen of 48 unique vaccine candidates, construct VC032 was prioritized, integrating a human β-defensin-3 adjuvant via specialized linkers. VC032 achieved ≥99.8% HLA coverage across African outbreak epicenters and globally. Tertiary structure prediction and refinement confirmed favorable stereochemical quality (92.5% Ramachandran favored). Molecular docking and 100-ns all-atom molecular dynamics with the human TLR1/TLR2 receptor complex demonstrated stable interfacial engagement (mean 977 contacts, 29 hydrogen bonds) and robust binding free energies (MM-GBSA: −216.84 ± 15.27 kcal/mol). Immune simulations in V032 predicted coordinated B-cell and Th1-skewed memory responses. In silico codon optimization and virtual cloning into pET-28a(+) established translational feasibility for bacterial expression, delivering a broad-spectrum pan-orthoebolavirus vaccine blueprint. Further experimental validation is required.

papers.title_zh: VC032 的计算设计和生物物理评估:针对四种人类致病性正博拉病毒的多表位 疫苗 候选药物
papers.source_body_en: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD), caused by four human-pathogenic Orthoebolavirus species (Bundibugyo, Sudan, Taï Forest, and Zaire ebolaviruses), presents severe mortality (40%–90%). Licensed vaccines confer protection exclusively against Zaire ebolavirus, leaving persistent vulnerabilities against heterologous species due to 30%–40% envelope glycoprotein divergence. To address this, we executed proteome-wide immunoinformatics screening across 20,723 viral sequences encompassing seven structural and non-structural proteins. Multi-tier filtering for MHC restriction, conservancy, non-allergenicity, and human proteome non-homology identified 24 conserved epitopes across five viral targets (GP, VP35, VP24, L-polymerase, NP). From a combinatorial screen of 48 unique vaccine candidates, construct VC032 was prioritized, integrating a human β-defensin-3 adjuvant via specialized linkers. VC032 achieved ≥99.8% HLA coverage across African outbreak epicenters and globally. Tertiary structure prediction and refinement confirmed favorable stereochemical quality (92.5% Ramachandran favored). Molecular docking and 100-ns all-atom molecular dynamics with the human TLR1/TLR2 receptor complex demonstrated stable interfacial engagement (mean 977 contacts, 29 hydrogen bonds) and robust binding free energies (MM-GBSA: −216.84 ± 15.27 kcal/mol). Immune simulations in V032 predicted coordinated B-cell and Th1-skewed memory responses. In silico codon optimization and virtual cloning into pET-28a(+) established translational feasibility for bacterial expression, delivering a broad-spectrum pan-orthoebolavirus vaccine blueprint. Further experimental validation is required.
papers.abstract_zh: 埃博拉病毒病 (EVD) 由四种人类致病性正埃博拉病毒(本迪布焦、苏丹、塔伊森林和扎伊尔埃博拉病毒)引起,呈现严重的 死亡率 (40%–90%)。获得许可的 疫苗 专门针对扎伊尔埃博拉病毒提供保护,但由于 30%–40% 的包膜糖蛋白差异,导致针对异源物种的持续脆弱性。为了解决这个问题,我们对包含七种结构和非结构蛋白的 20,723 个病毒序列进行了蛋白质组范围的免疫信息学筛选。针对 MHC 限制性、保守性、非过敏性和人类蛋白质组非同源性的多层过滤,确定了 5 个病毒靶点(GP、VP35、VP24、L-聚合酶、NP)的 24 个保守表位。从 48 个独特的 疫苗 候选物的组合筛选中,构建 VC032 被优先考虑,通过专门的连接子整合人类 β-defensin-3 佐剂。VC032 在非洲 暴发 震中和全球范围内实现了 ≥99.8% 的 HLA 覆盖率。三级结构预测和精炼证实了良好的立体化学质量(92.5% Ramachandran 青睐)。与人 TLR1/TLR2 受体复合物的分子对接和 100 ns 全原子分子动力学证明了稳定的界面接合(平均 977 个接触,29 个氢键)和强大的结合自由能(MM-GBSA:-216.84 ± 15.27 kcal/mol)。V032 中的免疫模拟预测了协调的 B 细胞和 Th1 偏向的记忆反应。计算机密码子优化和虚拟克隆到 pET-28a(+) 中建立了细菌表达的翻译可行性,提供了广谱泛正埃博拉病毒 疫苗 蓝图。需要进一步的实验验证。

papers.title: Nanosensors for Homeland Security
papers.abstract: Dangers to homeland security are posed by explosives and biothreat agents. Explosives considered are TNT, tetryl, picric acid, and RDX. Among the biothreat agents, anthrax spores, plague, Francisella tularensis and Brucella bacterium, smallpox and Ebola viruses, and ricin, SEB toxin, and aflatoxin require speedy, accurate detection. Eight types of nanosensors for TNT, two types for TNT/Tetryl, five types for picric acid, and four for RDX/other explosives are described. Two types of nanosensors for anthrax spores, one for plague bacterium, two types for Francisella tularensis bacterium, three types for Brucella, one type for Variola virus, three types for Ebola virus; and three types each for ricin, SEB, and aflatoxin are pondered over. These nanosensors include a miscellany of techniques, including colorimetric devices, luminescence in various forms (photoluminescence/fluorescence/electroluminescence), fluorescence intensity quenching via Meisenheimer complex formation, surface plasmon resonance, surface-enhanced Raman scattering, Raman spectroscopy, and electrochemical phenomena.

papers.title_zh: 用于国土安全的纳米传感器
papers.source_body_en: Dangers to homeland security are posed by explosives and biothreat agents. Explosives considered are TNT, tetryl, picric acid, and RDX. Among the biothreat agents, anthrax spores, plague, Francisella tularensis and Brucella bacterium, smallpox and Ebola viruses, and ricin, SEB toxin, and aflatoxin require speedy, accurate detection. Eight types of nanosensors for TNT, two types for TNT/Tetryl, five types for picric acid, and four for RDX/other explosives are described. Two types of nanosensors for anthrax spores, one for plague bacterium, two types for Francisella tularensis bacterium, three types for Brucella, one type for Variola virus, three types for Ebola virus; and three types each for ricin, SEB, and aflatoxin are pondered over. These nanosensors include a miscellany of techniques, including colorimetric devices, luminescence in various forms (photoluminescence/fluorescence/electroluminescence), fluorescence intensity quenching via Meisenheimer complex formation, surface plasmon resonance, surface-enhanced Raman scattering, Raman spectroscopy, and electrochemical phenomena.
papers.abstract_zh: 爆炸物和生物威胁剂对国土安全构成威胁。考虑的炸药有 TNT、四硝基苯、苦味酸和黑索金。在生物威胁因子中,炭疽孢子、鼠疫、土拉弗朗西斯菌和布鲁氏菌、天花和 埃博拉病毒、蓖麻毒素、SEB 毒素和黄曲霉毒素需要快速、准确的检测。描述了八种 TNT 纳米传感器、两种 TNT/Tetryl、五种苦味酸纳米传感器和四种 RDX/其他炸药纳米传感器。两种炭疽芽孢纳米传感器,一种用于鼠疫细菌,两种用于土拉弗朗西斯菌,三种用于布鲁氏菌,一种用于天花病毒,三种用于埃博拉病毒;并考虑了蓖麻毒素、SEB 和黄曲霉毒素各三种类型。这些纳米传感器包括多种技术,包括比色装置、各种形式的发光(光致发光/荧光/电致发光)、通过迈森海默复合物形成的荧光强度猝灭、表面等离子体共振、表面增强拉曼散射、拉曼光谱和电化学现象。

news.content: Skip to main content Help Log in ReliefWeb Search Content Search What are you looking for? Search|t Updates Countries Disasters Organizations Topics Jobs Training Informing humanitarians worldwide 24/7 — a service provided by UN OCHA South Sudan South Sudan Ebola virus disease preparedness: Costed interim readiness proposal Format Manual and Guideline Source OCHA Posted 17 Nov 2026 Originally published 17 Nov 2026 Attachments Download Report (PDF | 1.04 MB) Introduction South Sudan has not reported any confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases. However, ongoing transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), coupled with continued cross-border movements through formal and informal entry points, poses a high risk of importation. The DRC outbreak continues to expand, with 10,920 confirmed cases and 5,323 deaths, representing a case fatality rate of 48.7 per cent across 67 health zones in 8 provinces. Haut-Uele Province, which borders Western and Central Equatoria, has reported 486 cases and 213 deaths, including a confirmed case in Dungu, near the South Sudan border – a development of particular concern. The recent importation of cases into Kenya and Nigeria further underscores the risk of cross-border transmission, with the World Health Organization (WHO) identifying South Sudan as having the highest risk of EVD importation in Africa. As part of national preparedness efforts, South Sudan conducted a national full-scale simulation exercise (FSX) from 19 to 23 October 2026. The exercise was nationally coordinated and implemented with technical support from the WHO, the United Nations Children’s Fund, the Africa Centre for Disease Control and Prevention and the FHI 360 STRIDES project. It followed the tabletop simulation exercise completed in June 2026, as well as multiple drills conducted in laboratories, newly established isolation facilities and several training sites. The FSX simulated EVD detection scenarios at 10 sites across 3 hubs: Juba (4 sites), Yei (3 sites) and Yambio (3 sites). The scenarios were designed to test nine EVD preparedness and response pillars. South Sudan has also investigated multiple credible alerts largely originating from the 15 high-risk counties, with the highest number of alerts coming from Yambio and Magwi, near the border with DRC and Juba, the capital. These alerts complement the latest WHO risk estimates, which have identified the cities of Rumbek, Bor and Wau as additional geographical areas to consider when strengthening EVD preparedness. Following six months of EVD preparedness and readiness operations, the FSX documented strengths in early detection. However, the exercise also identified a number of critical weaknesses at key operational handover points across the response chain, requiring targeted corrective action and additional support. news.content_zh: ReliefWeb 于 2026 年 11 月 17 日发布的这份报告概述了南苏丹为 埃博拉病毒病 (EVD) 所做的准备工作。报告指出,南苏丹尚未报告任何埃博拉病毒病确诊病例,但强调了由于刚果民主共和国(刚果民主共和国)持续发生的 传播 疫情带来的输入风险。截至 2026 年 11 月 17 日,该国已有 10,920 例确诊病例,5,323 例死亡。靠近南苏丹边境的栋古报告了一例确诊病例,引发担忧。报告强调,南苏丹已被世界卫生组织(WHO)确定为非洲埃博拉病毒病输入风险最高的国家。作为回应,南苏丹于 2026 年 10 月 19 日至 23 日进行了全国全面模拟演习 (FSX),在朱巴、耶伊和延比奥三个中心的 10 个地点模拟了埃博拉病毒病检测场景。此次演习测试了九个准备和响应支柱,并确定了响应链中的关键弱点,需要有针对性的纠正行动和额外支持。报告还提到,已经对可信警报进行了调查,这些警报主要来自靠近刚果民主共和国边境和首都朱巴的延比奥和马格维等高风险县。

Search|t Updates Countries Disasters Organizations Topics Jobs Training Informing humanitarians worldwide 24/7 — a service provided by UN OCHA DR Congo + 6 more Multi-country Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease Outbreak Situation Report No. 26 (2 – 8 November 2026) Format Situation Report Source IOM Posted 13 Nov 2026 Originally published 13 Nov 2026 Origin View original Attachments Download Report (PDF | 3.67 MB) OUTBREAK CONTEXT As of 7 November, transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remained concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu, with 67 health zones and 271 PoE/PoC locations affected. In Kenya, no new confirmed cases were reported, and five patients were discharged during the reporting period. Nigeria has recorded one confirmed imported case; as of 8 November, 26 of the 62 identified contacts had completed follow-up, with no contact testing positive.* [...] During the reporting period, seven deceased persons were intercepted at IOM-supported PoEs/PoCs, bringing the cumulative total to 266. The deceased were referred to the surveillance team for sample collection and to the Safe and Dignified Burial (SDB) team for burial. In addition, 35 alerts were identified, of which 20 were verified/referred. No confirmed cases were detected at IOM-supported PoEs/PoCs during the reporting period. news.source_body_en: The Multi-country Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease Outbreak Situation Report No. 26, dated 2–8 November 2026, highlights the ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with transmission concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu regions. As of 7 November, 67 health zones and 271 PoE/PoC locations were affected. In Kenya, no new confirmed cases were reported, and five patients were discharged during the reporting period. Seven deceased persons were intercepted at IOM-supported PoEs/PoCs, bringing the cumulative total to 266. The deceased were referred to the surveillance team for sample collection and to the Safe and Dignified Burial (SDB) team for burial. Additionally, 35 alerts were identified, of which 20 were verified/referred. The report was posted on 13 November 2026, indicating the current status of the outbreak and the response measures being taken.
news.content_zh: 2026 年 11 月 2 日至 8 日发布的第 26 号多国 Bundibugyo 埃博拉病毒病 暴发 情况报告强调了刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 正在进行的 暴发,其中 传播 集中在伊图里和北基伍地区。截至 11 月 7 日,67 个卫生区和 271 个 PoE/PoC 地点受到影响。肯尼亚无新增确诊病例,报告期内已有5名患者出院。在 IOM 支持的 PoE/PoC 中拦截了 7 名死者,使累计总数达到 266 人。死者被转交给 监测 团队进行样本收集,并转交给安全和有尊严的埋葬 (SDB) 团队进行埋葬。此外,还发现了 35 个警报,其中 20 个已得到验证/转介。该报告于2026年11月13日发布,说明了暴发的当前状态以及正在采取的应对措施。

epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo – 17 November 2026 WHO Director-General's opening remarks at the third IHR Emergency Committee meeting on Bundibugyo virus disease epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo – 17 November 2026 17 November 2026 Remarks Geneva Reading time: Chair, Professor Lucille Blumberg, Members of the Emergency Committee, dear colleagues and friends, Thank you once again for your commitment to this Committee. I also thank the representatives of the Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Nigeria, South Sudan and Uganda for joining us today. Six months have now passed since this outbreak was declared, and three months since this Committee last met. In that time, the number of cases has more than doubled. More than 11 000 cases and 5400 deaths have now been reported, in 67 health zones across eight provinces. Children are paying a terrible price. They account for more than a quarter of confirmed cases and one third of deaths. Seven in ten children under five with confirmed Ebola have died. The risk beyond the DRC’s borders is not theoretical. Kenya has reported nine cases linked to an imported case, including two deaths. Its last patient has been discharged, and the 42-day countdown has begun. Nigeria has reported one imported case. In both countries, rapid detection and management of cases show the value of preparedness, transparency and swift control measures. I remain concerned that some countries continue to apply blanket travel restrictions. They hinder the response, damage livelihoods and discourage countries from reporting outbreaks quickly. Targeted, evidence-based measures work better. There is also real progress. Rapid transmission has been halted in most of the early epicentres. At the start of the outbreak, two laboratories could test for the virus. Today there are more than two dozen. Close to 2000 treatment beds are now available, and about 3000 people have recovered. And research is progressing. Clinical trials of therapeutics are progressing, with more than 900 people enrolled; Last month, a vaccine trial began using the Ervebo vaccine, which is approved for Ebola virus, but not for Bundibugyo virus. Two candidate vaccines developed specifically for Bundibugyo virus will be added to the trial in the coming weeks. But vaccines are not a substitute for the measures that save lives now: early care, contact tracing, isolation, safe and dignified burials, and trusted engagement with communities. But progress in some places is not control of the outbreak as a whole. Between 400 and 500 new cases are still reported every week, and the outbreak is still expanding in some areas. When this Committee last met, I said that what concerned me most was where people are dying. That has not changed. Two-thirds of confirmed deaths are still occurring outside of Ebola treatment centres, which tells us that infections are being identified too late. Contact follow-up remains below target. Insecurity is now one of the greatest obstacles to the response. Earlier this month, an attack on the town of Cantine-Aloya killed 66 civilians, including three health workers. Health facilities were looted and burned, and more than 1000 contacts were lost to follow-up. Two weeks ago a nurse was killed and another health worker badly injured when they were attacked while responding to an Ebola alert in Tshopo province. These incidents restrict humanitarian access, disrupt operations, make it harder to reach communities quickly, and give the virus an advantage – the virus can freely move while the response is restricted. Delays in paying frontline health workers and responders are also causing tension and slowing the response. And we must always remember that Ebola is just one of the threats these communities face, which means the response must also protect essential health and humanitarian services. Outbreak control cannot come at the expense of primary health care, maternal and child health services, or access to treatment for other diseases. Once again, thank you all for your time and expertise. I look forward to your assessment of the situation, and to your advice. I thank you. news.source_body_en: The WHO Director-General addressed the third IHR Emergency Committee meeting on the Bundibugyo virus disease epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on 17 November 2026. The outbreak, which has been ongoing for six months, has seen the number of cases more than double since the last committee meeting. Children under five are particularly vulnerable, with more than a quarter of confirmed cases and one third of deaths. Kenya has reported nine cases linked to an imported case, including two deaths, while Nigeria has reported one imported case. Despite progress in some areas, the outbreak is still expanding, and insecurity poses a significant challenge. An attack on Cantine-Aloya killed 66 civilians, including three health workers, and disrupted operations. Contact tracing remains below target, and two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centres, indicating late identification of infections. Research is advancing, with clinical trials of therapeutics and vaccine trials for Bundibugyo virus, though vaccines are not a substitute for immediate measures like early care and safe burials. news.content_zh: 世卫组织总干事于 2026 年 11 月 17 日在《国际卫生条例》突发事件委员会第三次会议上就刚果民主共和国本迪布焦病毒病疫情发表讲话。暴发 已持续六个月,自上次委员会会议以来,病例数增加了一倍多。截至目前,八个省的67个卫生区已报告超过11,000例病例和5,400例死亡。五岁以下儿童尤其容易受到伤害,超过四分之一的确诊病例和三分之一的死亡病例。肯尼亚报告了 9 例与输入病例有关的病例,其中 2 例死亡,而尼日利亚报告了 1 例输入病例。尽管在某些领域取得了进展,但 暴发 仍在扩大,不安全因素构成了重大挑战。Cantine-Aloya 的袭击造成 66 名平民死亡,其中包括三名卫生工作者,并扰乱了行动。接触者追踪仍低于目标,三分之二的死亡发生在 治疗 中心之外,这表明感染识别较晚。研究正在取得进展,针对本迪布焦病毒的治疗临床试验和 疫苗 试验,尽管 疫苗 并不能替代早期护理和安全埋葬等即时措施。由于一线工人工资延迟和持续的安全威胁,应对措施受到阻碍。

news.content: Skip to main content Help Log in ReliefWeb Search Content Search What are you looking for? Search|t Updates Countries Disasters Organizations Topics Jobs Training Informing humanitarians worldwide 24/7 — a service provided by UN OCHA South Sudan Humanitarian Coordinator calls for strengthened Ebola readiness in South Sudan Format News and Press Release Source OCHA Posted 17 Nov 2026 Originally published 17 Nov 2026 Attachments Download Report (PDF | 168.32 KB) Juba, 17 November 2026 – The United Nations Resident Coordinator and Humanitarian Coordinator in South Sudan, Mr. Ramanathan Balakrishnan, has called for increased preparedness and readiness to respond to a potential Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the country. The call follows a recent full-scale simulation exercise conducted in October 2026 by the Ministry of Health, the National Public Health Institute (NPHI), the World Health Organization (WHO) and partners to assess the country's capacity to detect, notify, investigate and respond to a potential EVD outbreak. The exercise assessed key areas of South Sudan’s Ebola preparedness efforts, including case management, infection prevention and control, laboratory capacity, contact tracing and coordination. While the exercise demonstrated the system’s capacity to quickly detect simulated cases, significant gaps remain in alert management, rapid response team management, health worker remuneration, ambulance services, laboratory facilities, personal protective equipment supplies, contact tracing, and screening arrangements at points of entry. To address these challenges, the Humanitarian Coordinator has launched a three-month prioritised plan to mobilise financial resources to address the operational and capacity gaps identified during the simulation exercise. He called on donors and partners to support the plan, which requests USD$7 million to strengthen preparedness and response capacities. “While there are no reported cases of Ebola in South Sudan, closing these preparedness gaps is critical to ensure that South Sudan is better prepared to detect, contain and respond to a potential outbreak, and to protect the lives and well-being of its people,” Mr. Balakrishnan said. Reiterating the importance of national government leadership in strengthening EVD preparedness, Mr. Balakrishnan said, “The payment of health worker salaries by the government authorities is critical, as is facilitating access for Ebola-related movements for both health actors and UNMISS and ensuring the safety and security of humanitarian workers.” Disclaimer UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs To learn more about OCHA's activities, please visit https://www.unocha.org/.
